Jin: Quick question for the room 80% curiosity, 20% procrastination				
If you had one mundane task at work that could be made magically effortless by an everyday household item, what item would it be and what task would it do for you?
Noah: Microwave. reheats lunch perfectly without the mystery cold spots.
Sofia: A Roomba that's also a cable manager. collects dust *and* untangles chargers. dream gadget.
Eli: Magnet strip that also archives sticky notes. slap one on my forehead memory.
Noah: @Sofia also vote for a Roomba that brings coffee.
Jin: @Eli "archives sticky notes" = yes. i'd call it the Sticky Archivist. :smile:
sam-bot: poll created: React with :one: for Microwave, :two: for Roomba-cable, :three: for Magnet-archiver, :four: for Other + comment
Sofia: voted :two:
Eli: voted :three:
Noah: voted :one:
Jin: voted :four: A tiny labeler that auto-generates file names when you hit save.
Sofia: low-key now imagining a future office with robot librarians.
Eli: this is the most useful brainstorming we've done all week.
Noah: can we put these ideas in the office wishlist? @ops?
Jin: @ops feel free to steal. we'll accept implementations in the form of chocolate.
Sofia: motion to name the Roomba "Cable Carl". seconded. :laughing:
Eli: Cable Carl for the win.
Jin: okay that's enough workplace innovation for one Slack thread. thanks y'all, brightened my afternoon.
